title: Remove UI scroll/navigation buttons from Featured row

requirements.text: Remove the left/right UI scroll navigation buttons from the FeaturedRow so no overlay scroll controls are rendered, while keeping the FeaturedRow horizontally scrollable via native input (trackpad/mouse wheel/touch swipe).
acceptanceCriteria: In `frontend/src/components/FeaturedRow.tsx`, the left and right navigation `<Button>` elements (ChevronLeft/ChevronRight) are no longer rendered.
The FeaturedRow content remains horizontally scrollable using native scrolling (e.g., touch swipe/trackpad) with `overflow-x-auto` preserved.
No unused imports or dead code remain in `FeaturedRow.tsx` (e.g., remove `Button`, `ChevronLeft`, `ChevronRight`, and the `scroll` callback if no longer used).

After removal, the FeaturedRow layout has no empty reserved space that previously accommodated the buttons (adjust any horizontal padding such as `px-12 sm:px-16` as needed so cards align naturally within the container).

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (Shadcn components are read-only).
Keep changes scoped to removing UI scroll/navigation buttons; do not alter unrelated trailer playback behavior or backend APIs.
nonGoals: Adding replacement navigation UI (e.g., pagination dots, new buttons, keyboard shortcuts) unless required to preserve native scrolling.
Changing the FeaturedRow data fetching behavior or curated content logic.
